metadata.description: Eighteen red lethal crosses fill a six-by-three lattice divided by staggered cyan walls. Six yellow ring bouncers begin in two clusters: three at the upper right and three at the lower left. Three cyan patrols start on the top rail and one on the bottom-left rail. Start at bottom center, go sideways around the central divider, and enclose the hazards to reveal 75%.
